mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines over the past month, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months with UNRATE increase > 0.3pp, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate housing market contraction that reduces household wealth and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or interaction term coefficient is not statistically significant (p>0.05) over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO below 100) signals manufacturing sector weakness that reduces corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals strong aggregate demand that supports corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where RSAFS increases quarterly, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Two consecutive months of industrial production decline below 100 indicate manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with two consecutive INDPRO < 100 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment (UNRATE below 4.0%) during labor market tightness erodes corporate profit margins through wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Annual CPI inflation exceeding 3.5% signals persistent inflation that triggers central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months with CPIAUCSL > 3.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
